name: qos-migration-agent
description: Translate QoS configuration from ASR 900 (IOS-XE), NCS 540/55xx (IOS-XR) or ASR 9000 (IOS-XR) to Cisco 8000 IOS-XR using the config-translation skill, with per-section confidence and human-approved deployment-workflow generation.

metadata.suggestion: I want to run a QoS migration to Cisco 8000

prompt.description: e.g. 'migrate node-16 QoS to Cisco 8000' or 'list QoS migration candidates'.

response.description: Translated Cisco 8000 QoS + confidence report, or status.

load_to_cnc.description: Enable the load stage (load template->NSO, import workflow->CWM, NSO dry-run) on 172.20.163.49. OFF disables all writes; never commits device config.

cnc_user.description: CNC username the agent uses to fetch a CAS token from 172.20.163.49 (default admin).

cnc_password.description: CNC password for cnc_user; the agent fetches its own CAS JWT. Leave blank to use cnc_token instead.

cnc_token.description: Optional pre-minted CNC bearer token (fallback when cnc_password is blank).
